description: Let’s be real about why we really have today off. We call it “Labor Day,” but the federal holiday on the first Monday of September didn’t drop out of thin air, and it definitely wasn’t made to sell mattresses or mark the end of summer. Naw, today exists because of a Railroad Fireman from Terre Hau
